items.title: Google rolls out Gemini AI voice assistant to Apple CarPlay dashboards
items.summary: Investing.com -- Alphabet Inc's (NASDAQ:GOOGL) Google is expanding its reach across Apple Inc's (NASDAQ:AAPL) ecosystem by bringing its Gemini artificial intelligence assistant directly to Apple CarPlay. The integration allows drivers to conduct hands-free, two-way conversations with Gemini Live through vehicle dashboard displays, with all voice exchanges automatically syncing back to the iOS app.
